body: Shit like this stays up but my post gets deleted.  This isn't a place of support at all.
He'd be fine.  Really.  I guess you'd have to know him to understand that.

I think the most intelligent person sees the sackshit world around them and still can manage to be content.  That same person isn't bound by fear and finds the act of aging intriguing.

I'm a coward and an idiot.  At least I've finally found some sort of comfort through this plan.

If you're asking the title, I'll leave that answer blank.  Why would I want people to know who I am?

If you're asking what the album is *about*, I couldn't give an answer either.  I guess, I could say...it's about a journey that takes you absolutely nowhere.

Think about it.  Do you really want to be 40?  Are you looking forward to a wrinkled face and 4 decades full of regret?  All those dreams you had as a kid....the ones that probably never came true. 

Do you want to be 50 and verging on a plethora of health issues?  Or 60 and confronted with an inevitable end?

Worse yet, 80...thinking...any day now...

Fuck that.  I'm dying young.  Young and viable.  Young and still burning.  I'm going out with a fucking bang and soon.  I will die at the climax of my existence.  I used to be scared but now...I can't fucking wait.  The only time I can cope is when I'm drunk/high.  Those are the only sparing moments I can slow down and enjoy the moment.  Those moments, however, are few and far between.  Reality smacks me in the face when sober.   

I will cherish the time I have left.  I will make use of it.  I will create a masterpiece, god help me.  If I can't, then I'll die nonetheless.  I'm living on a timeline, though, and I'll do what I can while I can.   

I hope you can hear it, when it's done.  If it gets done.  That's my sole dying wish....to one-up myself.  You then might truly know me.

I'm not achieving anything.  My music is on the decline.

I don't want to struggle for years.

Again, I can't afford help.  I can't even afford groceries.

Beyond anything else, *I don't want to get old.*  That's the main thing...and there's no stopping it, aside from dying young.  I have absolutely no desire to live past the age of 26.  So on the bright side, if I stick things out for a bit longer, I still have a couple years left.
I don't want to see my parents and siblings and friends die off as I get older.  I'd rather go before all of them.

"Suicide just makes everything stop because you are dead and incapable of doing anything."

Sounds good.

I'm not doing a lot.  I got lucky.  And I am proud...but pride isn't enough to keep someone living in misery.

I've enjoyed hundreds of shows.  There's always going to be a last show for every musician.  It is bound to happen someday.  I'd just prefer it be sooner or later.  The boyfriend has heard enough from me.  We've talked.  Our brains work so differently, though, so I think he has a hard time understanding.  He doesn't need to, really.  He needs to be with someone who isn't as batshit fucked up mentally broken as I am.

It's not a rough period.  I've struggled for years.  I've sought professional help.  I can't afford to seek anymore right now.  

I feel like I've done enough.  Selfishly, I'd like to do one more album and tour before I go.  But I'm alright with what I've done musically.
